items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And during that we period recorded 1st Bassman. Ernie Wilkins wrote the music for uh the bassist um...Ray Brown.

ctx.x: He was giving me a lot of uh record sessions, when I, I finally got enough money to, to purchase a home in Teaneck, New Jersey, because of Mingus and Ernie Wilkins. And during that we period recorded 1st Bassman. Ernie Wilkins wrote the music for uh the bassist um...Ray Brown.
